scope: Full-game primary moneyline, spread/run-line/puck-line and total; seven sports; props and alternate/period markets excluded.
authority: Retrieval configuration only. Capability examples are not a guarantee of current, free, whole-slate coverage, calibration, independence or integration permission.

projectUse.scope: Current VigScope operation; do not infer commercial use solely from product/customer language.

fangraphs.notes: Use pregame Game Odds, with pitchers and lineups. Live win expectancy is not a pregame forecast.

dratings.notes: Win probabilities and projected scores are different fields. Bet Value/Base Rating/Bet Trends/Sharp Line components and displayed sportsbook odds are not outcome probabilities. MLB injury and late-starter assumptions require review.

collection.reason: Public probability board is readable through source research; direct HTTP returned 403 in verification. No bypass or unverified automated adapter.

stats_insider.notes: Public dated MLB articles supplied exact run-line/total percentages. Game hub access differs. Australian date must be matched to event UTC. Same source family as Dimers.

dimers.notes: Use public exact market tabs or dated articles. Free selections and coverage vary. Syndicated Dimers articles remain CIPHER; a second publisher is not a second model. Archive updates after tip establish capability only.

collection.reason: Terms restrict automated collection and commercial redistribution. No scraper configured; a permitted feed or source-specific permission is needed.

ats_io.notes: A named MLB exact-total probability was verified. Price/break-even inconsistency in sampled prose requires own-price arithmetic and field validation. Not a proven whole-slate feed.

nfelo.notes: NFL win and exact-cover fields verified. Model-calculation timestamp and model total were not verified; resolve timestamp before treating a value as currently eligible.

collection.reason: Public maintainer CSV; use only exact current season/week and ordered teams verified against the event schedule.

talisman_red.notes: NCAAF projected margin/total only in verified route. Do not convert to cover or total probability without a separately validated distribution.

cleanup_hitter.notes: Use distinct own projected-score column; market-estimated team totals are different. Limited method detail; no exact CFL cover/total probability verified.

dunks_threes.notes: Dated NBA public game win probability verified. Recheck free in-season access and expected participation; custom minutes/API access is paid. No exact spread/total probability verified.

espn.notes: Upcoming WNBA Matchup Predictor percentages verified. Match actual event, calculation time and personnel assumptions; a today heading is insufficient.

collection.reason: Existing public scoreboard and game summary routes; match ordered teams and kickoff; preserve missing probability semantics.
collection.coverage: Fetch event summaries for active sports; retain context-only when no predictor field exists. Availability is measured per event.

moneypuck.notes: Include MoneyPuck's public pregame NHL win forecasts in current non-commercial research and exact-market aggregation. Preserve source field, original observation time, model family and attribution. Confirmed goalie display does not prove forecast recomputation for that goalie. Deserve To Win, in-game win probabilities, playoff odds and historical expected goals are not pregame game-win forecasts. No documented pregame forecast export verified.

collection.reason: User confirmed current non-commercial use. Include public pregame forecasts in event research and capture usable values through the existing evidence contract. Listed data-page downloads are free for non-commercial use with attribution. MoneyPuck separately requests approval for scraping data not listed on its data page; automated pregame scraping is not configured.

puckcast.notes: Upcoming NHL win percentages verified, with preseason regressions and seven-day model changes. Inconsistent method/validation claims remain unresolved. Not a qualified probability fallback by default.

oddstrader.notes: Observed article/board line and side conflicts. Verify actual selected side, exact line, probability and time together. Do not reconstruct a probability from undefined displayed EV.

prediction_tracker.notes: Catalog advertises over 50 systems; live tables contain fewer models/variants and may still show completed games. Record original models separately. Catalogue averages/model dispersion are descriptive, not another independent model, game variance or calibrated fair. Home-positive margins differ from sportsbook handicaps.

collection.reason: Discover original models and verify exact slate. Commercial bulk reuse permission is not established.

bet_better.notes: Separate score export publishes scores, home margin, total and home-win probability. NFL upcoming board verified October 6. Picks API exposes selected free picks; other fields locked/null. Never replace missing probability with 50%, infer cover/total probabilities or an away complement/tie/OT convention. Proprietary methods and unverified performance.

collection.reason: Publisher documents CC BY 4.0 commercial use with attribution. Only uniquely matched priced rows; failures remain explicit.

playerwon.notes: Nine current October 6 NHL matchups had V2 win probabilities. V1/V2 share one family. Displayed performance sample was 42 games. Stat CSV downloads are not a prediction export. Preserve page/time; review goalie assumptions and full-game OT/SO settlement.

collection.reason: Free reading verified; commercial automated collection/redistribution permission is unestablished. Use only permitted source captures.

covers_oddsshark.notes: October 6 board supplied nine NHL and two MLB predicted scores. Sportsbook ML/spread/total prices, including percentage-format odds, are NOT model outcome probabilities. Expert picks and computer scores differ. Count Odds Shark syndication once; native score/margin/total context only.

collection.reason: Public score research leads; no authorized commercial automated feed established. Do not scrape or treat book odds as model probabilities.

the_margin.notes: Documents weekly frozen NFL/CFB CSV and static JSON; current file access needs verification. NFL CSV market_total is the bookmaker total, not a model total. NFL model disclosed not to beat market. CFB priors include SP+ and limited new-team market priors. Freeze time does not prove pregame public availability.

collection.reason: Invites tracker/grader/research exports; commercial redistribution unresolved. Verify current file, actual observation and exact schedule.

podium_oracle.notes: Current NHL probabilities and held-back results verified. Own evaluation trails books; goalie adjustment small and xG/shot data absent. ESPN raw data is not ESPN matchup predictor. Review OT/SO settlement and rounding. No spread/total probability verified.

collection.reason: Free reading; terms require written permission for commercial/bulk reuse. CSV downloads are subscriber feature.

MLB:moneyline.notes: FanGraphs dated scores first; DRatings then public Cipher access. ESPN full-game matchup predictor fields were verified September 27; preserve raw percentages and review personnel/settlement.

MLB:spread.notes: Run line. A dependable second separate free run-line model remains unverified.

MLB:total.notes: Exact line is mandatory for exact-probability coverage; score totals remain context.

NFL:moneyline.notes: nfelo market regression and uncertain model time must remain visible.

NFL:spread.notes: Public NFL tabs first; dated Dimers articles are another access route, not another model.

NFL:total.notes: A second dependable free exact-total provider remains unverified.

NCAAF:moneyline.notes: DRatings includes FCS-involving games. CollegeFootballData pregame win probability is spread-derived, not independent team forecasting.

NCAAF:spread.notes: Public Dimers-origin exact-cover articles; syndication adds access only. Complete FCS coverage unverified.

NCAAF:total.notes: Projected total points are not an Over/Under probability.

CFL:moneyline.notes: Dedicated DRatings CFL win board; check UTC/local event date.

CFL:spread.notes: Keep the exact-cover gap explicit; no invented score-to-probability conversion. Qualified Pinnacle assessment remains available under existing rules.

CFL:total.notes: No free exact O/U probability verified. DRatings Bet Value components are not event probabilities.

NBA:moneyline.notes: DRatings is a proposed additional lookup; this guide did not verify a current NBA slate.

NBA:spread.notes: Free dated public articles demonstrate field availability, not present slate coverage.

NBA:total.notes: Free exact-line selections; archive pre-tip values for prospective tracking.

WNBA:moneyline.notes: ESPN/DRatings upcoming values; check injury weighting and calculation time.

WNBA:spread.notes: Sample article updated after tip; historic value cannot be represented as observed pregame.

WNBA:total.notes: Selected free access, not guaranteed whole-slate probabilities.

NHL:moneyline.notes: Include MoneyPuck in current non-commercial pregame research with MoneyPuck.com attribution. Verify exact event, observed pregame probability, full-game settlement and goalie assumptions; listing the route is not collected coverage.

NHL:spread.notes: Puck line; a second separate exact-line model remains unverified.

NHL:total.notes: Half-goal examples verified; integer totals require known push conventions.

aggregationPolicy.scope: Aggregate applicable forecasts, native projections, personnel, Graham fair and market prices by exact contract; retain contrary evidence and access gaps.
aggregationPolicy.authority: Descriptive comparison only; no automatic fair, grade or stake.
aggregationPolicy.syndication: Catalogue entries and copies retain the original model family; a catalogue is not another model.
